# strand

> Easy creation of non-blocking tasks


## Pages in this subsection

- [strand](strand.html.md): Utilities for running functions in other contexts
- [strand.constants](strand.constants.html.md): Page content
- [strand.taskrunning](strand.taskrunning.html.md): Taskrunners
- [strand.taskrunning.base](strand.taskrunning.base.html.md): Taskrunner base class
- [strand.taskrunning.coroutine](strand.taskrunning.coroutine.html.md): A taskrunner that calls functions in coroutines
- [strand.taskrunning.decorators](strand.taskrunning.decorators.html.md): Decorators to simplify taskrunner syntax
- [strand.taskrunning.multi_dispatch](strand.taskrunning.multi_dispatch.html.md): Defines the TaskDispatcher class.
- [strand.taskrunning.multiprocess](strand.taskrunning.multiprocess.html.md): A taskrunner that calls functions in separate processes
- [strand.taskrunning.store_reader](strand.taskrunning.store_reader.html.md): A taskrunner that reads task definitions from a store and runs the tasks
- [strand.taskrunning.store_writer](strand.taskrunning.store_writer.html.md): A taskrunner that writes task definitions to a store
- [strand.taskrunning.thread](strand.taskrunning.thread.html.md): A taskrunner that calls functions in threads
- [strand.taskrunning.utils](strand.taskrunning.utils.html.md): | &#96;conditional_logger&#96;(&#91;verbose, log_func&#93;)          | Returns a logger function if verbose is True,...
